what: The risky-test uplift domain: a provider-proposed test that exercises a REAL external tool (ffmpeg, LabVIEW's CLI) that hosted CI cannot provide. Tool-gated acceptance: SKIP when the tool is absent, run + gate when present.

cases.present-pass: tool=node (always present) + a passing test -> verdict=pass (risky-test-runs ok)
cases.absent-skip: an absent required tool -> verdict=SKIP (not fail); a skipped check is recorded
cases.present-fail: tool present + a failing test -> verdict=fail

ffmpeg.ollamaProposed: verdict=fail -- llama3.1:8b wrote CommonJS require('child_process') in an ESM .mjs (require is not defined) -> the test threw -> the gate correctly FAILED it (teeth)
ffmpeg.correctTest: verdict=pass -- a correct ESM `ffmpeg -version` test ran the real /usr/bin/ffmpeg (tool-present:ffmpeg ok, risky-test-runs ok, exit 0)

labview.cli: LabVIEWCLI (capital) at /usr/local/bin/LabVIEWCLI -- IS on PATH (the earlier lowercase 'labviewcli' skipped only due to case)
labview.hostRun: tool=LabVIEWCLI on the host (LabVIEW 2026 Community, VI Server enabled port 3363): a LabVIEWCLI MassCompile ran -- 'Connection established with LabVIEW at port number 3363' + 'MassCompile operation succeeded' -> risky-test-runs ok -> verdict=PASS
labview.cleanroomVM: on the scratch VM LabVIEW LAUNCHES under Xvfb with -LabVIEWPath (NOT activation-blocked for launch); LabVIEWCLI additionally needs the VI Server enabled in ~/natinst/.config/LabVIEW-2026/labview.conf (server.tcp.enabled=True, port 3363) -- added. A real VM run also needs a virtual display (Xvfb).

safety: The risky-test executes a provider-proposed test that invokes a real tool. The DETERMINISTIC gate uses node itself as the always-present tool (safe). UNTRUSTED provider-proposed tests that drive ffmpeg/LabVIEW run in the DISPOSABLE cleanroom VM -- exactly where the Ollama ffmpeg test above executed -- not on a trusted host. The host LabVIEW pass used a TRUSTED, hand-authored LabVIEWCLI test (not provider-generated code).
note: The same domain gate is a deterministic skip under the dependency-free CI suite (no ffmpeg/LabVIEW) and a real proof where the tool exists. Linux LabVIEWCLI needs -LabVIEWPath + a display (Xvfb when headless) + the VI Server enabled in labview.conf; with those the LabVIEW risky-test PASSES against real LabVIEW 2026 Community.
